system.description:
You surround yourself, in dense lightning chakra in the form of armor of your description and color. This alteration of color also extends to other jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword you cast signifying your unique attributes gaining the listed benefits. For the duration, you enter an Overdrive state, granting you the following benefits;

Gain a +1 Bonus to AC.

Gain a +20 bonus to movement speed.

Gain a Rank of Mastery in Dexterity Saves

Overcharge. For the duration, you can take the dash action as a Bonus Action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the movement speed bonus by +10. If you cast this jutsu at B-Rank or higher, your Overdrive state adds +1d10 Lightning damage to your unarmed, Ninjutsu and Taijutsu attacks, twice per turn, and the bonus to attacks now also apply to your unarmed attacks.

If you cast this jutsu at A-Rank or higher, your Overdrive state grants you a +4 DR. This becomes +8 if applied to Earth or Lightning damage.

If you cast this jutsu at S-Rank the Bonus to damage becomes +2d10 and the bonus to AC becomes +2.
